thread:
Diego: Quick check — Nexus on-prem staging needs network clearance for customer demo Friday. Main open items: firewall egress fallback, jumpbox image signed, and air-gap package transfer path. Who's the owner on each? @Amy @Ben please chime in.

Amy: I can own the jumpbox image + signing. Image build is green but still waiting on the HSM key rotation window. ETA for signing is EOD tomorrow.

Ben: I can take the egress fallback plan. Current proposal: allow limited egress to update-check.redwood.ai on 443 with ACL, otherwise route to local mirror. Need list of IPs and expected domains from NetOps.

Clara: NetOps here — firewall ranges for staging are ready. Will need explicit CIDR for the customer's load balancer and the NAT device. Our minimal list: 10.10.0.0/16 (staging pod range), 172.20.5.0/24 (jumpbox), and these external destinations: 54.210.33.12/32 (mirror), 18.205.9.0/24 (updates). Also need peering request with their VPC; can someone file the ticket with their VPC ID + ASN?

Diego: Clara — assigning you network owner. Ben — please use those CIDRs and draft the fallback ACL. Amy — please post the signed image digest here once done.

Ben: Draft ACL snippet (will open PR shortly):
```
# allow update-check to mirror only
-A INPUT -s 172.20.5.0/24 -d 54.210.33.12/32 -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -s 172.20.5.0/24 -p tcp --dport 443 -j DROP
```
I'll tighten once we confirm all external IPs.

Amy: HSM rotation window approved for 03/28 14:00-15:00 PT. I'll kick the signing job at start of window. Image tag will be nexus-staging-2026-03-28.

Eli: Quick note on air-gap: Customer requires SHA256-signed artifact bundle and checksum file on a thumbdrive. Ops runbook needs: hash verification, agent package install order, and rollback steps. I can draft the runbook but need the final artifact name and checksum.

Ben: I'll include mirror sync verification in the PR and output a checksum artifact. Amy — can the image build pipeline produce a checksum file alongside the signed image?

Amy: Yes — pipeline will upload image + image.sig + image.sha256 to S3 (s3://redwood-private/nexus-staging/). I'll share presigned URL in this thread once uploaded.

Clara: Filing peering ticket now. Ticket: NETOPS-4923. Attached: required CIDRs and desired route tables. ETA for peering acceptance dependent on their security team, but I'll ping them for an expedited review.

deploy-bot: CI for PR #6123 — egress-acl-draft passed lint, failing terraform fmt. (https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/6123)

Ben: Noted, will fix fmt and push. PR link in a bit.

Diego: Ownership summary: Network -> Clara; Egress fallback & ACLs -> Ben; Jumpbox image signing -> Amy; Air-gap runbook -> Eli. If anyone can't meet ETA, call it out here. Demo Friday remains target. :thumbsup:

Amy: ACK — will post signed artifact + presigned URL after 03/28 14:00 PT.

Eli: I'll start runbook draft today and link it here.

Clara: NETOPS-4923 updated with customer VPC ID and ASN. I'll follow up with them this afternoon.

Ben: Pushed fmt fix, CI passed. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/6123

Diego: Great work team. If we hit a blocker, escalate in #incidents and ping me directly.

Amy: :thumbsup:

Ben: :rocket:

Eli: Will post runbook link when ready.
